primary_text: "Can I actually buy a warehouse through my super? The rules seem complicated." You're not the only business owner asking this question. The good news: SMSF commercial property purchases are well-established and perfectly legal when structured correctly. You can buy a warehouse through your super and lease it back to your own business at market rate. We've helped dozens of owners navigate this exact process with Truganina warehouses. Near Princes Freeway, West Gate Tunnel, and Port of Melbourne. Download our free SMSF commercial property guide.
description: Free downloadable guide covering SMSF rules for commercial property purchases
